spans.text: This corpus was made in collaboration with [Platfòm MIT-Ayiti](https://mit-ayiti.net/), who kindly allowed us to utilize their the Haitian Creole educational materials to create the MIT-Haiti Corpus (An kreyòl « *Bank done MIT-Ayiti* »).

entries.description: Machine Translation systems and **monolingual** Haitian data
entries.subject: Machine Translation

spans.text: In this corpus you will find **parallel** data (ht-en, ht-fr, ht-es), sourced from multilingual childrens stories, to evaluate Machine Translation systems and **monolingual** Haitian data, sourced from lesson plans and blog posts, which can be used for continued pre-training, for example.
